// diagnostic

L0514

Adjacent categorical guards over `{subject}` can be one ordered subject table

What

Adjacent categorical guards over `{subject}` can be one ordered subject table

Why

Exclusive guards repeat one stable subject; an ordered table keeps the categories together

Fix

Rewrite as `if {subject} == { … }` and group aliases with `|`; see `examples/suites/dispatch.jet`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0514: tests/ui_lint/adjacent_subject_dispatch.warn.

Warning [L0514] (same_subject_dispatch): Adjacent categorical guards over `key` can be one ordered subject table

    |     ^^
 Why: Exclusive guards repeat one stable subject; an ordered table keeps the categories together
 Fix: Rewrite as `if key == { … }` and group aliases with `|`; see `examples/suites/dispatch.jet`
